_comment: Phase 8 hand-built retrieval test set. Every question was written after reading actual chunk text from data/processed/document_chunks.csv (not guessed from document titles/filenames), and every expected_document_id/expected_page_number was verified by running the real retrieval service against the built index (see docs/RAG_SYSTEM.md 'Test-question methodology'). expected_min_rank is the worst rank (at top_k=5) the expected chunk was observed at during that verification run -- used by the test suite to assert the expected chunk stays within top-k, not necessarily rank 1.
